description: Prepare (never execute) a domain registration: returns the safety-checked plan only. Step 2 of the two-step purchase flow. Show the plan, with the locked total and fee, to the human first. Note: the ThatMgmt API does not expose an execute endpoint for this action (purchase, renewal, transfer, and DNS changes are never executed by the API). This tool returns the validated plan only. Show the locked price to the human first.
